general: TypeScript strict mode — no 'any', no implicit 'any'
All functions must have typed parameters and return types
Max function length: 50 lines. Extract helpers if longer
Max file length: 300 lines. Split modules if longer
No commented-out code in committed files
No TODO comments without Issue/ticket reference
backend: Follow NestJS module anatomy from wiki/techstack/backend.json
Controllers: HTTP layer only. No business logic
Services: Business logic only. No HTTP-layer concerns
All DTOs use class-validator. No manual validation in services
All entities extend BaseEntity (id, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt)
All monetary values stored as decimal(15,0) — VND has no cents
frontend: All components are function components. No class components
Props interfaces define all props. No inline type literals in JSX
Server state via React Query. Client UI state via Zustand. No dual storage
All VND amounts formatted with formatVND() from lib/formatters.ts
All date/times formatted with formatDate() or formatDateTime()
Accessible by default: all interactive elements are focusable, labeled
testing: Unit tests for all service methods (happy + error paths)
Integration tests for all controller endpoints
E2E tests for all user-visible flows per acceptance criteria
Coverage minimum: 80% lines for backend, 70% branches
